SELECT b.id AS id, b.batch_no AS batch_no, b.biz_date AS biz_date, b.status AS status, b.well_group_id AS group_id, g.group_code AS group_code, g.group_name AS group_name, b.test_section_id AS section_id, s.section_code AS section_code, b.shift_id AS shift_id, sh.shift_code AS shift_code, b.monitor_point_id AS point_id, mp.point_code AS point_code, mp.well_name AS well_name, (SELECT MIN(r.pressure_mpa) FROM t_wellhead_reading r WHERE r.batch_id = b.id) AS batch_pressure_min, (SELECT MAX(r.pressure_mpa) FROM t_wellhead_reading r WHERE r.batch_id = b.id) AS batch_pressure_max, b.create_time AS create_time FROM t_monitor_batch b INNER JOIN t_well_group g ON g.id = b.well_group_id INNER JOIN t_test_section s ON s.id = b.test_section_id INNER JOIN t_reinjection_shift sh ON sh.id = b.shift_id INNER JOIN t_monitor_point mp ON mp.id = b.monitor_point_id
ORDER BY b.biz_date DESC, b.id ASC LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}
